name: Pressure Gauge
summary: Round pressure gauge with a red danger zone and a moving needle on a pipe stub; for plant and engineering scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: floor line: the pipe rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 about 440 px wide and 550 px tall (hero size); use about 0.3 next to a person

params.name: value
params.note: needle position 0 to 1 (used when anim is none, wobble or pop)

params.name: anim
params.note: sweep = the needle swings across the dial

author: krakujs
